lines.en: Rin invites me in again and the two of us kill time together in her room.
lines.zh: Rin 又把我请了进去，我俩在她房间里一起消磨时间。

lines.en: She shows me some of the music she’s been into lately and a lot of it seems eerily depressing.
lines.zh: 她给我听了一些她最近迷上的音乐，其中不少都阴郁得有点瘆人。

lines.en: I’m surprised that someone as cheerful as her listens to things like this, but
lines.zh: 像她这么开朗的人居然会听这种东西，我挺意外的——不过

lines.en: I guess it’s never good to judge a book by its cover.
lines.zh: 我想，果然还是不能以貌取人。

lines.en: Plus, she collects human skulls so it’s not like she’s exactly “normal.”
lines.zh: 再说了，她还收藏人类的头骨，所以她也谈不上多「正常」。

lines.en: Eventually, Futaba sends her a text that she’s on her way back and
lines.zh: 后来 Futaba 发短信说她正在往回走，于是

lines.en: the two of us decide it’s best for me to head out.
lines.zh: 我俩一致认为，我最好还是先撤。
